zh: 那只猫爬到树上下不来了。
en: The cat can't {get down|climb down|come down} from the tree.

zh: 市政府把那棵老松树砍掉了。
en: The council {cut down|chopped down|felled} the old pine tree.

zh: 昨晚的霜冻把我的番茄全冻死了。
en: Last night's frost {killed off|killed|wiped out} all my tomatoes.

zh: 周末我喜欢在花园里摆弄花草。
en: I love {pottering about|pottering around|puttering around} in the garden at the weekend.

zh: 暴风雨把整片庄稼都毁了。
en: The storm {wiped out|destroyed} the whole crop.

zh: 这道围栏应该能把负鼠挡在外面。
en: This fence should {keep out} the possums.

zh: 我们家的老狗不得不被安乐死了。
en: Our old dog had to be {put down|put to sleep}.

zh: 毛毛虫会变成蝴蝶。
en: A caterpillar {turns into|becomes|changes into} a butterfly.

zh: 农场主把羊群赶到了一起。
en: The farmer {rounded up|gathered up|herded|gathered} the sheep.

zh: 冬天要把玫瑰修剪一下。
en: You should {cut back|prune} the roses in winter.

zh: 一头死鲸鱼被冲上了海滩。
en: A dead whale {washed up|washed ashore} on the beach.

zh: 狗追着猫跑了。
en: The dog {went after|chased|ran after} the cat.

zh: 这个周末我们要把旧草坪挖掉。
en: We're going to {dig up|rip up|pull up|tear up} the old lawn this weekend.

zh: 你可以把狗拴在外面。
en: You can {tie up} your dog outside.

zh: 那只狗开始低吼，我就慢慢往后退。
en: When the dog started growling, I slowly {backed away|stepped back|moved away|backed off}.

zh: 那只狗追着猫跑过了花园。
en: The dog {ran after|chased} the cat across the garden.

zh: 他们收养了一只流浪猫。
en: They {took in|adopted} a stray cat.

zh: 恐鸟几百年前就灭绝了。
en: The moa {died out|disappeared} hundreds of years ago.

zh: 猫不肯从树上下来。
en: The cat won't {climb down|come down|get down} from the tree.

zh: 种之前先往土里拌些堆肥。
en: {Dig in|Mix in|Work in} some compost before planting.

zh: 请勿践踏草坪。
en: Please {keep off|stay off} the grass.

zh: 新西兰大部分电力来自水电。
en: Most of New Zealand's electricity {comes from} hydro.
